question: Under a matched branch-sealed protocol, does conditioning the bounded interpolation calibrator on observation-derived values materially outperform a static-coefficient calibrator?

falsifiable_claim.claim: Observation-conditioned calibration must explain at least 0.5% structured improvement beyond static learned coefficients, while retaining at least 1% improvement over ordinary linear interpolation.

shared: bit-identical parameter initialization within each dataset
same fit windows, K3/K2 objective, masks, data order, optimizer and 20-epoch budget
same source-dev checkpoint selection and tune targets
exact_method_difference.static_zero: All 16 MLP input channels are exactly zero. The MLP heads can express only three learned global coefficients; the fixed outer interpolation formula still uses observed anchors, distances, anchor delta and local volatility.
exact_method_difference.blinear_only: Only the ordinary linear interpolation value B_linear is visible to the MLP.
exact_method_difference.value_only: Only B_linear, observed value, observation mask and local volatility are visible to the MLP. At missing targets, observed value and mask are zero, so the additional effective input beyond B_linear is primarily local volatility.
exact_method_difference.only_difference: fixed feature-channel masking before the shared MLP

headroom_probe.reason: The first unresolved mechanism is whether the existing learned gain needs any sample-varying MLP input at all.

training.objective: equal mean of K3 missing-target and K2 middle-anchor-drop normalized MAE
training.checkpoint: lowest source-dev ratio-of-sums NMAE pooled over all three masks; ties choose earlier epoch

stage.name: prototype
stage.future_seeds: not registered; any confirmation requires a separately frozen protocol after a proceed verdict

metrics.primary: ratio-of-sums NMAE on immutable missing targets
metrics.dataset_aggregation: compute each dataset relative effect from pooled structured error/truth sums, then average the two dataset effects equally

uncertainty.method: paired circular-window block bootstrap within each dataset
uncertainty.shared_draws: all methods and mask families share window selections

decision_rule.kill: If either value-only point-effect minimum fails, kill the input-conditioning method claim; blinear-only cannot rescue it.
decision_rule.revise: If both point effects pass but any primary robustness gate fails, report revise and do not add seeds.
decision_rule.proceed_blinear: If all primary and blinear simplification gates pass, carry only the one-channel calibrator into a separately frozen confirmation.
decision_rule.proceed_value: If all primary gates pass but any blinear simplification gate fails, carry value/local-scale conditioning into a separately frozen confirmation.

stop_rules.kill: Do not run additional seeds and do not tune the feature masks or gates.
stop_rules.revise: Do not run additional seeds; inspect the failed robustness condition before defining a new method.
stop_rules.proceed: Do not use unregistered seeds in this protocol; freeze a separate confirmation protocol before further GPU training.

execution.infrastructure_retry: same job identity, command and hashes only
